svg.text: torch.split backward runs first: aten::cat reassembles the per-key gradients with one D2D copy per contributing tensor.
construct_jagged_tensors and SequenceEmbeddingsAwaitable are forward owners; backward executes their saved autograd nodes, not their Python bodies.
The remaining order is the exact reverse of forward: reverse_indices first, unbucketize_permute second.
If index deduplication is disabled, the first IndexSelectBackward0 branch is absent.
Activity IDs, sizes, kernel names and optimizer details illustrate one execution configuration; they are not fixed for every run.
